entities.name: Barbarian Migrations & Slavic Influence
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Gothic, Hunnic, Avar, and Slavic migrations through the Carpathian-Danubian region. Slavic settlement influenced the Romanian language (40% of vocabulary) and Orthodox Christianity. The First and Second Bulgarian Empires extended influence over parts of the territory.
